ini_comment: Internal game engine limits for map objects, scenario control etc. (not supported in Lua)
comment:
This section allows you to change previously hardcoded limits in the game engine. These were originally capped due to memory constraints and to maintain good performance.

Default limits in Tiberian Dawn have been doubled in NCO.

**Note: Changing these in Lua has no effect, they can only be set via rules.ini**

rules.name: TerrainMax
rules.comment: Maximum number of terrain object (trees etc.)

rules.name: TeamsMax
rules.comment: Maximum number of teams (instances of team types)

rules.name: TeamTypesMax
rules.comment: Maximum number of team types (reinforcements, teams for AI to build)
